title: NLTK: Compile-time regex DoS in NLTK search/tokenizer sinks: quadratic regex-engine compile bypasses the match-only…
description: NLTK versions 3.10.0 through 3.10.3 contain a compile-time regular-expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerability in their regex search and tokenizer functions. This vulnerability arises because the third-party regex engine used by NLTK compiles patterns with many capturing groups in roughly quadratic time, allowing an attacker to supply a crafted regex pattern that causes excessive CPU consumption during compilation. This leads to denial of service by exhausting CPU resources. The vulnerability does not affect confidentiality or integrity and is remediated in NLTK version 3.10.4.
